text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 11 November, up 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl on 10 November and 0.3% higher over one week, though it remains 29.1% lower over one month, within a range of 90.16 USD/bbl at the low and 129.95 USD/bbl at the high. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November, following the 28 September agreement under which Genel Energy is to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn and the 16 September promotion of the 1952 km² West Zohr Offshore block. Separately, Energean entered exclusive talks on 28 August for BP's West Nile Delta and Temsah stakes, valued at about USD 1 bn, while in Libya the NOC signed production sharing agreements with licensing round winners on 15 June.
